message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure while preserving energy by extending east level and accelerating rather than turning toward B0100; the opponent remained behind to the northwest, while two nearby eastbound missiles stayed north and increasingly lagged longitudinally.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to defeat B01001’s approaching intercept by sustaining a fast, steeply descending series of banked turns that shifts its track from southeast toward northeast, creating vertical and lateral displacement; the missile began behind to the northwest and continued closing despite the maneuver."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce exposure while preserving energy by extending east level and accelerating rather than turning toward B0100; the opponent remained behind to the northwest, while two nearby eastbound missiles stayed north and increasingly lagged longitudinally.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to defeat B01001’s approaching intercept by sustaining a fast, steeply descending series of banked turns that shifts its track from southeast toward northeast, creating vertical and lateral displacement; the missile began behind to the northwest and continued closing despite the maneuver.
